summary: Sturm, Ruger & Co. filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) disclosing a regular quarterly dividend of $11 per share declared by its Board of Directors. The dividend is payable on May 29, 2026, to stockholders of record as of May 14, 2026. The filing was prompted by the NYSE inadvertently releasing the information early. This is a routine dividend declaration and does not constitute a special-situation event such as a going-private transaction, tender offer, or other transformative corporate action.
